summary: Unilever PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting. Shareholders approved all 21 resolutions, including re-election of directors such as Nelson Peltz, ratification of auditors, and renewal of authorities to allot shares and disapply preemption rights. Voting was conducted by poll with detailed vote tallies provided. The filing is a routine disclosure of an annual meeting outcome and does not involve any extraordinary corporate event, merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or strategic review. No specific deal terms exist; this is a standard governance update under Rule 13a-16.
